prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE original painted-realistic editorial character portrait for Project Ulysses, a fictional Strangereal story. This is original supporting cast, never an existing Ace Combat character or a national government leader. Character: Sana Ivers, Osean controller. Appearance and mood: Late twenties; medium-brown skin, black hair in a low bun, brown eyes, thin round glasses. Plain dark control-room shirt, simple unmarked headset at the neck; quiet concentration. Head and shoulders, gently three-quarter toward the viewer, entire hair and head comfortably inside the frame with generous headroom and shoulder margin for later portrait-card crops. Portrait aspect 4:5. Realistic natural skin, individual facial features and believable eyes, subtle painted texture and practical cloth grain. Soft natural cool daylight and restrained navy/cyan surroundings; simple blurred service-room background without a recognizable location. Plain practical 1990s clothing, no rank or name patches. No hands, weapon, permanent injury, text, lettering, numbers, logo, flag, insignia, emblem, signature, watermark, yellow paint or overlay, UI border, collage, glowing cyberpunk lights or WWII costume. Fill the full image with the portrait and background; one person only. Framing requirement: a clearly visible empty background band above the hair, roughly one tenth of the image height; camera includes the upper chest and shoulders rather than a tightly cropped face.
